Name: Duel Start
Fires When: Either way, the moment its duel begins
Notes: The plain one. Use it when an ability should happen whichever side the card is on

Name: Attacking
Fires When: This card is the attacker in its duel
Notes: Half of the attack/defend pair. The attacker is decided by the clash

Name: Defending
Fires When: This card is the defender in its duel
Notes: The other half

Name: Win
Fires When: After this card WINS its duel
Notes: PHASE 4 WAS ALREADY BUILT. Win and Lose have been in the engine since the beginning - see BRAND_RALLY and BRAND_SCORCH in Abilities.csv, which both use this

Name: Lose
Fires When: After this card LOSES its duel
Notes: Also already built. A losing card that still does something is one of the better feelings in the game

Name: Passive
Fires When: Once at the start of every round
Notes: No condition at all. Applied and forgotten

Name: Flip
Fires When: The two cards are turned face up at the start of a duel
Notes: PHASE 2. The cards arrive face down and turn over together; anything written against `flip` goes off as they land. It fires BEFORE on_duel_start, so a flip ability can change what the duel starts with

Name: Reveal
Fires When: You press SHOW on this card during the draft, before the other side answers
Notes: BUILT. Showing the card chooses it AND names it: they answer a card they can see, taking their best in that tier instead of picking blind, and this ability fires there and then. If both sides show, the LOWER POWER resolves first. The button only appears on a card that has a reveal ability on it

Name: Contemplation
Fires When: This card ENTERS the Exhausted Zone
Notes: BUILT IN ROUND Y (C1). "If sent to Exhaust" on your cards. Fires when the round a card played in is over and it goes to the exhaust zone. PHASE 3. The zone itself comes first - a button that opens the pile of cards already played this cycle

Name: Rejuvenation
Fires When: This card LEAVES the Exhausted Zone
Notes: BUILT IN ROUND Y (C1). Fires at the end of the cycle, when every exhausted card walks back onto the field. PHASE 3. Everything comes back when the cycle is complete, so this fires on all of them at once

Name: Fused
Fires When: Two player units have become one
Notes: PHASE 5. The fused card replaces both, and the ladder still has to hold - one card per power per tier - so the replacement is a spawn like the Treant

Name: Last Player
Fires When: The card played in the PREVIOUS tier matched a condition
What It Needs: a memory of the last card
Notes: PHASE 6. 'Last player was a Brandteufel' - so a Tier I can answer what the Tier IV did. Needs the round to remember the tier before

Name: Marked
Fires When: This card carries a mark
Notes: PHASE 7. Mask is the example. A mark is temporary or permanent, and the Exhausted Zone is where a temporary one is cleaned off

Name: Counters
Fires When: This card has N counters of a named kind
Notes: PHASE 7. 'Enemy has 3 hypnosis counters: negate their ability'. Counters go on a card, ours or theirs

Name: Cards Left
Fires When: How many playable cards remain
Notes: PHASE 8

Name: Odd or Even
Fires When: Somebody's leftover exhaust points are odd, or even
Notes: PHASE 8. Cheap to add once the number is somewhere a condition can read

Name: Copy
Fires When: This card copies an ability
Notes: PHASE 9. Copying an ally's or an enemy's, or firing when they share one

Name: Swap
Fires When: This card sends the enemy's card back to their hand
Notes: PHASE 10. Higher priority wins, they must choose again, and they may not replay the same card

Name: Currency
Fires When: This card can pay a cost to activate
Notes: PHASE 11. Like counters but shown in its own window

Name: Last Side
Fires When: The previous card was attacking, or defending
What It Needs: a memory of the last side
Notes: PHASE 12. Also the hook for abilities that CHANGE who attacks

Name: Match Start
Fires When: Once, the first time the cards take the field
Notes: ROUND Y (C1). Both of a card's abilities are looked at.

Name: Round End
Fires When: After the shot, for the four cards that played the round - just before they go to the exhaust
Notes: ROUND Y (C1).

Name: End of Cycle
Fires When: When a cycle closes (at the STAR PLAYER SWITCH, and at full time for the last one), for every card in the match
Notes: ROUND Y (C1). "At the end of the cycle" on your cards.

Name: While in Exhaust
Fires When: At the start of EVERY duel, for each card sitting in the exhaust zone
Notes: ROUND Y (C1). "While in Exhaust" on your cards. Pair it with a Max of 1/cycle for "(once per cycle)", or it fires four times a round.

Name: After Duel
Fires When: After its duel is decided, win or lose - after on_win_duel / on_lose_duel
Notes: ROUND Y (C1).

Name: Shooting
Fires When: This card is about to shoot at goal. Anything it adds to the shot counts for THIS shot
Notes: ROUND Y (C1). "Shooting at goal" on your cards.

Name: Keeper Saves
Fires When: Your keeper has just stopped a shot - for every card on your side, wherever it is
Notes: ROUND Y (C1). "Goaly successfully defends". Narrow it with the If column: in_exhaust.

Name: We Scored
Fires When: Your side has just scored - for every card on your side
Notes: ROUND Y (C1). "After a goal" on your cards.

Name: We Conceded
Fires When: The other side has just scored - for every card on your side
Notes: ROUND Y (C1).

Name: While in Exile
Fires When: At the start of every duel, for each card in the exile zone
Notes: PHASE C5. "While in exile" on your Sitri cards.
